card.name: Linking words in drug interaction sections
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as for, on, with, following and other, placed in drug-interaction headings and sentences, right before a named drug, drug class or test is expected.

modes.label: Heading links
modes.description: Linking word in an interaction heading, before the affected drug or test.
modes.example: 7.2 Effects of Combined Hormonal Contraceptives on<< Other>> Drugs Table 4 provides significant drug interaction

modes.label: Links in interaction advice
modes.description: Linking word in a sentence about substrates or incompatible drugs, before the next drug name.
modes.example: Avoid the coadministration of BRAFTOVI with CYP3A4 substrates<< for>> which a decrease in plasma concentration may lead

card.writes: It promotes injection and diagnostic words and suppresses unrelated odd tokens, which suggests a push toward injection or diagnostic wording.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in drug-interaction text, just before the next drug or test is named.
